sources.title: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B: Open-Source Code Generation Model
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B is an open-source, decoder-only Transformer model built for code generation and intelligence, trained on a curated 2 trillion-token corpus across 87 programming languages. It employs innovative data selection via instruction-following difficulty with k-means clustering and dynamic pack tokenization to enhance training efficiency and performance. sources.title: DeepSeek Coder:
sources.snippet: DeepSeek Coder comprises a series of code language models trained from scratch on both 87% code and 13% natural language in English and Chinese, with each model pre-trained on 2T tokens.
